{"action": "write", "path": "intervals.py", "content": "def merge(intervals):
    """Merge overlapping or touching intervals.

    Given a list of [start, end] pairs (start <= end, any order), return a new
    list of disjoint intervals sorted by start. Intervals that overlap or
    touch are merged. The input is not modified.
    """
    if not intervals:
        return []
    ordered = sorted((start, end) for start, end in intervals)
    merged = [list(ordered[0])]
    for start, end in ordered[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if start <= last[1]:
            if end > last[1]:
                last[1] = end
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])
    return merged
"}
